valerius_m25_public_order_conclusion.title: The District Holds, But Not Quietly
valerius_m25_public_order_conclusion.text: Valerius studies the redeployed patrol map, then the record of the order you broke in public. Your earlier service still counts, but so does the institutional cost of overruling the Watch where everyone could see it. 'Good. Then we close this with the whole ledger visible: what you earned, what you spent, and what the district actually needed.'

responses.close: Then we leave the district in a state we understand, not one we can pretend is clean.

gronk_m25_quiet_network_conclusion.title: The Load Moves Because the Route Held
gronk_m25_quiet_network_conclusion.text: Gronk watches another contract caravan roll through on a manifest that finally matches the freight. 'You did not win by making everyone agree. You changed the route until the facts held under load. The Guild likes the numbers. Valerius likes that carts are moving. Silas likes that you did not spend people just to look decisive. That is enough agreement for one district.'

responses.close: Then the district keeps the route that works and the people who made it work remain people, not abstractions.

valerius_m25_ledger_aftercare.title: Who Can Examine the Patrol Ledger?
valerius_m25_ledger_aftercare.text: Valerius places the signed patrol ledger beside the redeployment map. 'There is no way to make the choice cost nothing. I will record what you asked me to do, and the Watch will have to answer for the review.'
valerius_m25_ledger_aftercare.decisionContext: Public patrols remain heavy. You can request an open merchant audit of the Watch ledger, sacrificing some command discretion, or request a dated internal Watch review that gives merchants less visibility. Neither choice means an unvisited contact already knows the ledger's contents.

responses.invite_audit: Ask Valerius to invite merchant auditors to review the signed patrol ledger.
responses.internal_review: Ask Valerius to keep a dated internal Watch review of the patrol ledger.

gronk_m25_manifest_aftercare.title: Where Should the Verified Manifest Go?
gronk_m25_manifest_aftercare.text: Gronk sets the audited freight manifest on his forge counter. 'The loads have been checked. That doesn't mean every desk needs the same copy at the same time. Tell me which review you want me to prepare, and I'll mark it against the original.'
gronk_m25_manifest_aftercare.decisionContext: Trade is moving again. You can request a signed copy for the Watch's review, granting institutional oversight, or keep the verified copy in the Guild ledger for now, preserving merchant control over its timing. This records a request to Gronk, not automatic knowledge in distant NPCs.

responses.watch_copy: Ask Gronk to prepare a signed manifest copy for the Watch's review.
responses.guild_ledger: Ask Gronk to keep the verified manifest in the Guild ledger for now.
